'''Nehanna''' was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, [[Gender/Legends|she]] disappeared under mysterious circumstances.<ref name="Strongholds" />
